acceptance.statement: Create without naming, restart and reopen the same identity.
Native rename preserves identity, Unicode and metadata authority.
Open failure/cancel preserves the prior valid route and content.
Recoverable removal and same-slot Undo survive reviewed races and recovery.
Storage failures are visible; no phantom durable items or lost user content.
Keyboard, accessibility, history and reduced-motion navigation preserve focus.
